purpose: Teach: 苦しん/吹い/溶け/埋める/泣か/空っぽ/傷つく/嫌がる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃん、長く苦しんでらしたから心配だわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma was suffering for such a long time. I was so worried about her.
lines.style: Soft, distant tone. Speaking partly to herself. A pause before his name — like gathering herself. Tender but tired. Not looking for reassurance, just... saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが風船を吹いてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad blew up a balloon for me!
lines.style: Bright, sudden energy. Quick attack on the excitement. Pulling her attention toward something lighter. A child's gift: distraction wrapped in joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、アイスが溶けるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your ice cream is melting.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Practical, but not sharp. A soft touch on the wrist — mother-voice finding the thread back to the present moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お庭の穴をぼくが埋めるね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to fill in the hole in the garden!
lines.style: Earnest, purposeful. Quick, eager tempo. Like he's offering something he thinks matters. Small voice trying to be helpful, to fix something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは泣かないお人よ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa doesn't cry. He's not that kind of person.
lines.style: Quiet, careful explanation. Speaking as if to herself as much as to him. Steady — teaching him something she believes matters. No lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの貯金箱、空っぽだよ
lines.en: Mom, my piggy bank is empty.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact voice with an undertone of quiet realization. Not complaining — observing. The way children report facts that hurt without naming the hurt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を傷つく言葉、絶対ダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you must never say things that hurt your friends. Never.
lines.style: Firmer. Steady conviction without harshness. The word 'never' lands with quiet weight. She's drawing a line he needs to see, but her voice stays warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お野菜を嫌がるよ
lines.style: Small, resigned voice. Almost matter-of-fact, like he's already lost this argument a hundred times. A whisper of wry acceptance underneath.
